{{Money|600}} (Group Bonus) |modifiers = [[Jailed Towers (Modifier)|Jailed Towers]] |rewards = {{Gem|100}}, {{Exp|300}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|2}} & 2 [[High Grade Crate]]s }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|After wave 5; once per wave, a tower type will be jailed per player.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Jailed Towers''' is a challenge map, which uses a modified version of the [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode as its mode. Triumphing on this map rewards the player with {{Gem|100}}, {{Exp|300}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|2}} and two [[High Grade Crate]]s. Like with other challenges, rewards can only be gotten once a week. ==Changes== The main change in this challenge is that after Wave 5, random tower type will be jailed. A tower type is every specific tower, like the [[Brawler]] or [[Minigunner]], placed down by a player. The towers that get jailed are not the same for each player. While jailed, these towers cannot be interacted with in most ways. This includes placing them down, selling them, upgrading them and using their abilities. These towers will also stop attacking enemies and will no longer summon units. Certain towers however are bugged and retain some or all of their abilities. There is also a secondary change, where the wave structure of this mode is slightly altered, making it harder. A few enemies also have their health altered: *[[Abnormal]] - 6 health ({{Color|No|-2}}) *[[Quick]] - 4 health ({{Color|No|-6}}) *[[Heavy]] - 16 health ({{Color|No|-44}}) *[[Breaker2]] - 50 health ({{Color|No|-30}}) *[[Fallen]] - 180 health ({{Color|No|-45}}) *[[Necromancer King]] - 14,000 health ({{Color|No|-61,000}}) *[[Cursed Skeleton]] - 500 ({{Color|No|-750}}) *[[Fallen Hero]] - 5,000 health ({{Color|Yes|+2,000}}) *[[Fallen Guardian]] - 14,000 health ({{Color|No|-18,000}}) *[[Fallen King]] - 75,000 health ({{Color|No|-125,000}}) A few enemies are also replaced: *[[Mystery]] is replaced by the [[Breaker2]]. *[[Mystery Boss]] is replaced by the [[Breaker4]]. *[[Dark Necromancer]] is replaced by the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]]. *[[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]] is replaced by the [[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]]. ===Wave Structure=== '''Bolded''' names indicates an enemy type's debut.

==Strategy== *Every wave after Wave 5, a tower will be jailed, making them unable to attack enemies, generate income, provide buffs and summon units. **The [[Elf Camp]] and [[Crook Boss]] can spawn units, even while jailed. **Units do not get jailed, even if the tower that spawned them is. This makes towers like the [[Engineer]], [[Military Base]] and [[Mercenary Base]] quite useful here. ***Do note that no new units will spawn from these if they are jailed. *As one tower type is locked every wave, multiple types of towers should be placed down before the towers start getting jailed. **Because of this, it is recommended to focus on multiple tower types instead of a single one. If all your DPS comes from a single tower type, it being jailed puts you at risk of dying to a wave. **Early on, you can place down Level 0 towers as bait, like a Level 0 [[DJ Booth]], so that they get jailed instead of your DPS towers, though do note that if you only have one reliable source of DPS, you are still at risk of having it jailed. *Do note that unlike regular [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, enemies spawn with the slime attribute here, allowing for [[Slime]]s to spawn. These can be quite dangerous, especially on later waves where they can turn into powerful enemies like the [[Tank]] or [[Summoner Boss]]. *Early on, a few enemies spawn as [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] enemies, making slow firerate and high damage towers a bit less effective here. *If your main DPS tower is not jailed on Wave 39, sell all copies of it and replace them on wave 40 so they are not jailed on the last wave. *If you are using [[Farm]], its best that you sell it at around Wave 38 or 39 and place a Level 0 one after that. **This enables you to gain additional income while increasing the number of towers you can use. *The [[Gatling Gun]] can be very useful here, as when it gets jailed while a player is using its ''FPS'' ability, the player will still be able to attack enemies with it. **However, trying to use the ''FPS'' ability after it got jailed will result in it not working. The gun will visually fire, but no damage will be dealt and no ammo will be lost. Other controls like reloading are also unusable. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} JailLeak1.png|Unused version of jailed towers in the development image. JailLeak2.png|Unused version of jailed towers in the development image. }} ==Trivia== *After the 19th of January 2025, this challenge would not appear until 182 days later, on the 20th of July 2025. ==Challenge History== *'''23 June 2024 – 30 June 2024''' **Map: [[Rocket Arena]] *'''21 July 2024 – 28 July 2024''' **Map: [[Crossroads]] *'''22 September 2024 – 29 September 2024''' **Map: [[Rocket Arena]] *'''12 January 2025 – 19 January 2025''' **Map: [[Chess Board]] *'''20 July 2025 - 27 July 2025''' **Map: [[Crossroads]] *'''17 August 2025 – 24 August 2025''' **Map: [[Rocket Arena]] ==Update History== *'''21 June 2024''' - [[v1.25.0]] **'''Jailed Towers''' added. *'''2 August 2024''' - [[v1.27.0]] **Now uses the new income system. **Buffs are no longer removed by '''Jailed Towers'''. **Updated to use the new [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode enemy appearances, some stats, health scaling and soundtracks. **Wave structure changed. **Now changes more enemy health values. ***[[Abnormal]] health now changes to 6. ***[[Quick]] health now changes to 4. ***[[Heavy]] health now changes to 16. ***[[Breaker2]] health now changes to 50. ***[[Fallen]] health now changes to 180. ***[[Fallen Hero]] health now changes to 5,000. ***[[Fallen Guardian]] health now changes to 14,000. ***[[Fallen King]] health now changes to 75,000. **Disabled dialogue. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **[[Enemies Beta]] removed. **{{Bug}} When activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, the mode is set to [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode instead of [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. *'''30 April 2025''' - [[v1.63.0]] **Due to changes with map names, [[Simplicity]] map is no longer [[Legacy Simplicity]] but [[Simplicity]] (previously [[Simplicity|Simplicity Remaster]]). *'''24 September 2025''' - [[v1.75.0]] **'''Jailed Towers''' can now be activated exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, as the challenges button in the lobby has been removed. {{ChallengeNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Jailed Towers}}
